stemMarkdown: A boat covers 48 km downstream in 2.6667 hours and the same 48 km upstream in 4.0000 hours. Find the speed of the stream (in km/h). (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Downstream speed $= \dfrac{48}{2.6667} = 18.0000$ km/h and upstream speed $= \dfrac{48}{4.0000} = 12.0000$ km/h. The stream speed is half their difference: $3$ km/h.
